title: Elevator Repair 308 West 150 St, MN
agency_path: City of New York > Housing Preservation and Development
submit_to: 100 Gold Street, Room 6-M3, New York, NY 10038
description_text:
NYC Department of Housing Preservation & Development ('HPD') is responsible to install and repair Elevators to ensure essential services. HPD has neither sufficient staff with the requisite expertise, nor the equipment necessary to perform this type of work. Qualified bidders must have three years' experience performing this type of work.

Prospective bidders are encouraged to engage with this procurement, access solicitation documents and submit bids through PASSPort: http://www.nyc.gov/BusinessOpportunities (search for '308 West 150'). Delivery of original bid security may be required as instructed in PASSPort.
